verdict.rationale: Mirrors uploads full agent session snapshots and traces to its service, so whether that data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. Local routing and app-controlled model calls are adjacent behaviors, not a training-data control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
